text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, I really did eat too much... 
The 'Super Horseshoe Combination Series 
Chocolates' that is...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still... there's still a bonus prize I 
haven't gotten yet... Hmmm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus found his heart torn between 
his skin breakout and the bonus candy 
toys.
